content: EcucReferenceValue describes EcucReferenceDef s, EcucChoiceReferenceDef s, and EcucForeignReferenceDef s in the Ecu Configuration Value description EcucReferenceValue provides the means to describe all kinds of reference definitions except an EcucInstanceReferenceDef , which is described by [TPS_ECUC_03033] in more detail.
